recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to light gray (#f2f2f2).
2. Add title text 'Combine Precision and Recall in one number' at top-left in large bold red font (#c00000).
3. Add slide number '13' in a circle at top-right.
4. Draw a large red-bordered rectangle on the left side for the confusion matrix.
5. Inside the matrix, add header 'Positive' in red on the left and 'Negative' in green on the right.
6. Add simple airplane line icons under each header.
7. Draw the Positive tree: root node red circle '30', branching via blue arrows to left red circle '20' (label 'TP' below in red) and right green circle '10' (label 'FN' below in red).
8. Draw the Negative tree: root node green circle '70', branching via blue arrows to left green circle '59' (label 'TN' below in red) and right red circle '11' (label 'FP' below in red).
9. On the right side, add a yellow rounded rectangle with 'Precision = TP / (TP + FP)' and below it a light blue rounded rectangle with blue border containing 'Recall = TP / (TP + FN)'.
10. Below the matrix on the left, add a green-bordered box with text: 'Good Model: Properly Classifies 20 out of 30 as Positive Properly Classifies 59 out of 70 as Negative'.
11. At the bottom, add three stacked boxes: yellow box 'Precision= 20/(20+11) =64.5%', blue box 'Recall= 20/(20+10) =66.6%', blue box 'Average= 64.5%+66.6% =65.55%'.
